correctness.rationale: For each nonempty subset A, inclusion-exclusion of the first uncovered coupon time gives E T=sum (-1)^(|A|+1)/p_A. On six symbols, fairness gives vertex degree M/2 and sum pair-codegrees 3M, yielding exactly 22+M/(M-1)-sum_pairs M/(M-c_e). Strict convexity forces balanced codegrees for each even M=2..20; independent exact Fraction arithmetic recomputed all ten upper bounds and found the unique maximum 157/36 at M=10, balanced pair-degree 2. The explicit ten triples were independently checked to have all vertex degrees 5 and all pair-degrees 2; direct 63-subset inclusion-exclusion independently gives 157/36, versus 327/76 for the full design. The five-symbol complement-cycle support computes 37/12<29/9, establishing the first-size cutoff.
